about: The fonts and sprites of the vendored map styles (apps/api/map/styles), fetched when the image is built by scripts/map-assets.mjs and checked against these SHA-256 (docs/design/self-hosted-maps.md §3.2). Their URLs carry the first 16 hex digits of this file's SHA-256: a change here is a new set of URLs, which every map loads afresh.

fonts.licence: Noto Sans, SIL Open Font License 1.1 (https://openfontlicense.org), as glyph PBFs of openmaptiles/fonts v2.0 (https://github.com/openmaptiles/fonts)

drawnByMapLibre.about: Code points MapLibre GL JS 6 draws with the browser's own fonts and never fetches (codePointUsesLocalIdeographFontFamily and codePointIsInComplexShapingScript in maplibre-gl): a range of 256 that lies wholly inside them is left out, 169 of every stack's 256 (CJK, Hangul, Kana, the Indic scripts). Check them when MapLibre's major version changes: a missing range is drawn locally, with a warning in the console.

sprites.licence: OpenFreeMap's sheet of OSM Liberty's icons (https://github.com/hyperknot/openfreemap-styles, MIT): the Maki POI icons, CC0 1.0 (https://github.com/mapbox/maki), and an arrow from Wikimedia Commons, public domain
